newsletter.title: TorxFlow Weekly Automotive Newsletter
newsletter.subtitle: Key updates for independent garages in the Netherlands and Europe

articles.title: Dealers positiever over importeurs - Aftersales Magazine
articles.summary: Dutch dealer-importer relations improve, boosting parts availability and pricing stability for independent garages.
articles.imagePrompt: a Dutch garage manager reviewing a parts invoice while speaking with a supplier representative over a desk
articles.imageAlt: Garage manager discussing parts supply with a supplier at a desk

articles.title: Yes, an EV really CAN power your home – if it’s one of these [update]
articles.summary: Explains how EVs with bidirectional charging can serve as home backup power, a service garages can offer to customers.
articles.imagePrompt: an electric car connected to a house via a charging cable, powering household lights during an outage
articles.imageAlt: EV supplying power to a home through a charger during a blackout

articles.title: BYD in Hongarije onder vuur: politie start onderzoek naar milieuovertredingen
articles.summary: Hungarian police investigate BYD for alleged environmental violations, potentially affecting parts supply and warranty support for European garages.
articles.imagePrompt: a BYD vehicle parked outside a Hungarian police station with officials examining documents
articles.imageAlt: Police officers reviewing paperwork near a BYD car in Hungary

articles.title: Subaru indefinitely postpones in-house EVs after profits plunge 90%
articles.summary: Subaru cancels its 2028 EV plans, opting to produce gasoline cars at its new factory, impacting future EV service demand for garages.
articles.imagePrompt: a Subaru factory floor with gasoline car assembly lines instead of EV equipment
articles.imageAlt: Subaru factory showing gasoline car production where EV lines were planned

articles.title: Kia is killing off its cheapest gas car, but a new EV will replace it
articles.summary: Kia discontinues its lowest‑priced gasoline model, replacing it with an EV, shifting future service workload toward electric vehicles for garages.
articles.imagePrompt: a Kia Picanto gasoline car being swapped for an electric Kia model on a showroom floor
articles.imageAlt: Showroom displaying a gasoline Kia Picanto replaced by an electric Kia vehicle
